_doc: The four lifecycles, defined once. The CLI enforces them, docs/LIFECYCLES.md and the diagrams are generated from this file, and tests check that every state and guard named in the docs exists here. Guards are named checks implemented in pmf/guards.py; a transition is refused when any guard fails.

DETECTED.meaning: Found at a gate, review or in the field. Not yet fully described.

LOGGED.meaning: In the register with one owner and a severity. Same day as detection.

TRIAGED.meaning: A decision record holds three options and a recommendation.

DECIDED.meaning: An option was chosen and recorded (signed for waive and defer).

RESOLVED.meaning: The chosen option was carried out and verified, or the waiver conditions are in place.

CLOSED.meaning: Management briefed (Sev 1 and 2) and a lesson captured.

DEFERRED.meaning: Option C chosen: carried as a known issue into a later release.

rules: Aging clock starts on the detected date, whatever state the issue is in.
Escalated is computed: an issue in an open state for more than escalation.days is flagged.
A Sev 1 or Sev 2 must appear in the current RAID snapshot (pmf raid).
Changing severity is an event on the same state, not a transition; it is logged with a reason.

ASSESSED.meaning: Probability and impact scored (1 to 5 each); priority band known.

MITIGATING.meaning: An owner is running a mitigation plan.

ACCEPTED.meaning: A named approver accepted the exposure in writing.

OCCURRED.meaning: The triggering event happened. A linked issue was created.

RETIRED.meaning: No longer a threat (event passed or mitigated away).

rules: Risk score = probability x impact (1 to 25); the profile maps the score to a priority band and a review interval.
Re-scoring is an event on the same state. A risk not re-scored within its band's review interval is flagged stale.
A Critical or High risk cannot be ACCEPTED without a named approver and a note.

REQUESTED.meaning: Asked for, logged as a candidate ECR. No work committed.

ASSESSED.meaning: Effort, cost, schedule and risk sized; tier computed.

APPROVED.meaning: Every approver required by the tier signed. Work may start.

DEFERRED.meaning: Accepted but moved to a later release.

IMPLEMENTED.meaning: Work done; budget row and baseline updated.

VERIFIED.meaning: Result checked against the change request.

rules: No cost or schedule is committed before APPROVED. Work that starts earlier is a process failure, logged as an issue.
Tier = the highest of the cost tier and the schedule tier; the profile lists the approvers per tier.
When cumulative approved cost passes change_control.escalate_cumulative_pct of the baseline budget, pmf check warns that a formal re-baseline is due.

PLANNED.meaning: On the calendar with exit criteria.

REVIEW.meaning: Review meeting held or in progress.

CONDITIONAL_GO.meaning: Proceed; every unmet criterion has a signed waiver.

NO_GO.meaning: Do not proceed. An issue was logged for each unmet criterion.

rules: Planned gates and issue-triggered gates are listed apart; status reports never mix them.
A gate may be added after kickoff only as type issue-triggered, with the issue that caused it.
Gate on-time rate counts completed planned gates whose actual date is on or before the baseline date.

sev1.meaning: Extra obligations while a Sev 1 is open.
checklist: Exec notice sent the day it was detected
Daily war-room update logged until RESOLVED
Triage record with three options within the profile's Sev 1 cadence

guards.has_required_fields: id, title, description, phase, owner, severity and detected date are all filled.
guards.single_owner: Exactly one named owner (no team names, no lists).
guards.valid_severity: Severity is one of the levels in the profile.
guards.valid_phase: Phase is a phase id in the profile.
guards.decision_record_has_three_options: decisions/DR-NNN.md exists and its Options table has rows A, B and C, each with schedule and cost filled.
guards.decision_record_has_recommendation: The record has a non-empty Recommendation line.
guards.decision_chosen: The record names the chosen option (A, B or C), who decided and when.
guards.decision_signed_if_waive_or_defer: If the choice is B or C, the record says Signed: yes.
guards.option_is_fix_or_waive: The chosen option is A (fix now) or B (waive with conditions).
guards.verification_ref_present: A verification reference is recorded (evidence for a fix, the waiver conditions for a waiver).
guards.customer_acceptance_if_customer_visible: If the record says Customer visible: yes, a customer acceptance reference is present.
guards.brief_present_if_required: If the severity is in brief_required_for, briefs/B-NNN.md exists with all five sections filled.
guards.reason_present: A reason is given and logged in the event note.
guards.valid_probability: Probability is a whole number in the profile's scale.
guards.valid_impact: Impact is a whole number in the profile's scale.
guards.acceptor_named: A named approver accepted the risk (and a note is given for Critical and High).
guards.linked_issue_exists: linked_issue points to an existing issue in the issue register.
guards.sizing_present: Effort, cost delta, schedule delta and risk note are filled.
guards.all_tier_approvers_signed: Every approver the profile lists for the computed tier appears in approvers_signed.
guards.decision_ref_present: decision_ref points to an existing decision record.
guards.budget_row_logged: The cost delta is reflected in budget.csv (a forecast update dated on or after approval).
guards.exit_criteria_listed: The gate has at least one exit criterion in the profile.
guards.no_blocking_open_issues: No open issue has a severity listed in the gate's requires_no_open_severity.
guards.waiver_for_each_unmet_criterion: Every unmet criterion is covered by a waiver_refs decision record marked Signed: yes.
guards.issue_logged_for_each_unmet_criterion: An issue exists, with gate_found set to this gate, for each unmet criterion.
